entries.camera: Eye-level close-up, 85mm look, shallow depth of field with the face and brass goggles in sharp focus, a cluttered workbench softly blurred behind.
entries.subject: An elderly female rock gnome artificer, an alchemist and guild artisan, grinning with proud delight as she holds a small glass flask up to the lamp and watches the liquid inside shift from amber to green. A small, round-cheeked face with deep laugh lines, a slightly crooked nose with a faint soot smudge, bright sharp eyes magnified by a pair of brass goggles pushed up onto silver curly hair. She wears a snug scale-mail vest over a patched leather work apron, with stained fingertips and a few tiny burn scars on her hands. A plain dagger hangs at her belt beside a rack of corked vials. Behind her, a cosy cluttered workshop with copper tubing, hanging dried herbs and a small kiln glowing softly.
entries.accent: warm copper and amber lamplight with a pop of emerald green from the flask

entries.camera: High three-quarter shot from slightly above at desk level, 50mm look, the vial and the face both in focus, the translucent wings catching the light at the edge of the frame.
entries.subject: A young male fairy, a small-statured Fey artificer and alchemist-investigator, perched on a tall stool at an apothecary desk and squinting with intense curiosity at a vial of pale violet liquid held between two fingers. A delicate elf-like face with pointed ears, freckles, wide inquisitive eyes and untidy sky-blue hair, a pencil tucked behind one ear. Two large translucent insect-like wings are half open behind him, veined like stained glass and faintly shimmering. He wears a tailored waistcoat with many small pockets, a tiny satchel of reagents, and a dagger no longer than a letter-opener at his hip. Around him sit a magnifying lens, a notebook with sketched diagrams (no readable writing) and a half-eaten pastry, in the lamp-lit back room of a quiet town library.
entries.accent: soft lavender and mint with golden lamp glow and iridescent wing highlights

entries.camera: Frontal symmetrical medium close-up, 70mm look, perfectly level and steady, a tall scriptorium window blurred behind her.
entries.subject: A tall, slender female vedalken artificer in her forties, an armorer and former cloistered scholar, standing calmly with one palm held open in front of her where a small steady flame floats above it. Smooth hairless blue skin, a broad flat nose, no external ears, violet eyes lit warmly by the flame and an expression of serene, almost amused concentration. She wears a scholar's long dark robe with a compact plated arcane gauntlet and shoulder guard fitted over it, brass fittings polished like instruments. Her fingers show faint ink stains and a few tiny burn marks. Behind her, high shelves of bound books and a long desk with a mending kit and a half-repaired metal bracer.
entries.accent: cool cobalt blue skin with warm orange flame light and aged parchment gold

entries.camera: Wide low three-quarter shot from front-left, 24mm look, the whole centaur visible with all four legs, a grassy plain and a distant ridge at dusk behind.
entries.subject: An older male centaur artificer, an artillerist and practical problem-solver, standing on a windswept grassy hill and kneeling slightly on his front legs to adjust a small brass eldritch cannon bolted to a tripod in front of him. Human upper torso and head set on a full chestnut horse body with four legs, hooves, a thick barrel and a long dark tail. A weathered, thoughtful face with a grey-streaked beard, squint lines and patient half-lidded eyes, a pair of lenses on a cord around his neck. A leather harness crosses his chest with tool loops, a dagger and a coil of copper wire, and tiny sparks of acid-green light play along the cannon's muzzle. His expression is that of a man who has fixed this very problem many times and is mildly pleased to do so again.
entries.accent: dusty gold dusk grass, chestnut coat and a small acid-green glow

entries.camera: High-angle three-quarter shot looking down, 35mm look, the small construct and its mechanical companion in sharp focus, wet cobblestones reflecting lights.
entries.subject: A small autognome artificer, a battle smith, sitting on an upturned crate beneath a market awning on a rainy evening, the engineered face tilted up toward the viewer with an attentive, gently curious look. A compact metal body of overlapping bronze and steel plates, articulated joints, a deliberately crafted face plate with round glowing lamp-like eyes and a small hinged mouth grille, a tiny wisp of steam from a seam at the shoulder. A medium armour plating covers the torso and a round steel-banded shield rests on one knee, a dagger at its belt. Beside it sits a sturdy mechanical hound, its steel defender, with its head resting on the crate. Rain drips from the awning edge, and the glow of lanterns spreads in warm puddles.
entries.accent: weathered bronze and steel with warm lantern amber against cool rainy blue

entries.camera: Tight profile close-up, 85mm look, the face lit from one side by firelight, a snowy highland camp fading into darkness behind.
entries.subject: A broad, laughing female mountain dwarf barbarian, a battlerager, sitting by a campfire in a snowy highland pass with both hands wrapped around a steaming tin mug. Thirty-something, ruddy wind-chapped cheeks, a strong nose, completely beardless smooth cheeks and chin, and long auburn scalp-hair braids decorated with iron rings, one eyebrow split by an old scar, mirthful eyes squeezed half shut mid-laugh. She wears heavy studded leather with spiked steel pauldrons and a spiked gauntlet resting on her knee, a fur cloak thrown over a tree stump behind her. Her shoulders and thick forearms are marked with faded blue knot-work tattoos. Sparks rise from the fire into the cold night air and a pack mule dozes in the shadows.
entries.accent: fire orange and ember gold against deep indigo snow shadows

entries.camera: Low wide shot from the ground, 28mm look, the figure caught mid-leap across a stream with both hooves clearly visible, a sunny meadow and a mossy ravine below.
entries.subject: A young male satyr barbarian of the Path of the Beast, mid-leap over a sparkling stream with a whoop of pure joy, a warhammer swung loosely over one shoulder. An elf-like upper body with pointed ears and a wide, mischievous grin, curling ram-like horns, tousled chestnut hair and sun-freckled shoulders marked with green-ochre paint. Two furry goat-like hind legs end in cloven hooves, one tucked up and the other stretched out, and a short tail flicks behind him. A faint, translucent shimmer of a beast's claw and tail trails around him like heat haze, suggesting the totem within. He wears only a leather harness, a belt of tied-up charms and a rough kilt, and wildflowers are caught in his horns.
entries.accent: fresh meadow green and sunlit gold with a faint spectral amber shimmer

entries.camera: Eye-level medium shot from the side, 50mm look, backlit by a low sun through the open warehouse doors, a harbour wharf softly blurred outside.
entries.subject: A towering male human barbarian in his fifties, a former criminal now on the Path of the Giant, sitting on a stack of timber crates in a harbour warehouse and gently turning an enormous oversized war club in his hands as if weighing a long memory. A heavy, scarred face with a broken nose, grey stubble over a square jaw, a shaved head and quiet, rueful, deep-set eyes looking away from the viewer. Pale glowing rune-like marks, faint as breath on glass, trace the muscles of his forearms. He wears a patched dockworker's leather vest and a heavy chain scarf, and an old pickpocket's coin is threaded on a cord around his wrist. Dust hangs in the sunbeams and coils of rope and barrels crowd the edges of the frame.
entries.accent: hazy golden backlight with salt-grey shadows and a faint pale-blue rune glow

entries.camera: Three-quarter medium shot from behind-left at shoulder height, 50mm look, the wings and horns in the foreground and her face turned back toward the viewer, a ruined bell tower window behind.
entries.subject: A young female winged tiefling barbarian of the Path of Wild Magic, sitting on the stone sill of a ruined bell tower window at dawn with leathery wings folded loosely around her like a cloak, glancing back over her shoulder with a guarded, haunted look. Dusky violet skin, two curved dark horns, a slender tail curled around the sill, amber eyes with faint shadows beneath them and a short ragged black haircut. A scar runs across the bridge of her nose and a set of lockpicks and a small bundle of dried herbs hang at her belt. Her knuckles are bandaged and a few tiny motes of wild magic, soft violet sparks, drift lazily around her fists. A pale, almost imagined hint of a long-gone figure stands in the far doorway of the tower room, unthreatening, like a memory.
entries.accent: dusky violet and rose dawn with cool slate stone and soft magenta sparks

entries.camera: Slightly low frontal medium close-up, 40mm look, the draconic face centred and sharp, a snowy mountain temple terrace blurred behind.
entries.subject: A male white dragonborn barbarian of the Path of the Storm Herald in his thirties, standing on the snowy terrace of a mountain temple with one clawed hand raised and open, catching drifting snowflakes with a look of quiet reverence. An upright draconic humanoid with a dragon-like muzzle, frost-white scales shading to pale blue along the jaw and brow ridges, short swept-back horns and ice-blue eyes. A broad chest, clawed fingers and no wings. A small swirl of frost and snow orbits his shoulders in a calm tundra aura. He wears an acolyte's simple grey-white tabard cinched with a rope belt over fur-trimmed leather, and a string of carved prayer beads is wrapped around one wrist. The cold light is bright and gentle, and a row of weathered stone pillars is dusted with snow behind him.
entries.accent: frost white and glacier blue with a soft pearl-grey sky

entries.camera: Eye-level three-quarter medium shot, 85mm look, shallow depth of field, an autumn forest clearing in dappled light behind her.
entries.subject: A young-looking female eladrin barbarian with the Wolf totem, leaning with her shoulder against an old oak in an autumn clearing and smiling softly at something just beyond the viewer. Elf-like proportions, pointed ears and a fine-boned face, eyes glowing a gentle copper, long hair the colour of fallen maple leaves with a few small leaves caught in it, and an air of ageless calm that sits oddly against the claw-scarred leather bracers on her forearms. Her skin has a warm autumn flush and faint gold freckles. A translucent wolf stands quietly beside her, its pale outline made of drifting leaf-coloured light, its head tilted against her hand. She wears a fur-collared hide jerkin, a belt with a hand axe, and a leather band tied with a wolf's tooth.
entries.accent: autumn copper and burnt orange with soft gold light and a pale silver wolf glow

entries.camera: Low-angle wide shot on a ship's deck, 24mm look, the figure on the left third with a field of stars and a nebula towering above, rigging lines receding.
entries.subject: A broad-shouldered male astral elf barbarian of the Path of the Zealot, a former marine in his forties, stands at the rail of a spelljamming ship against a brilliant open starfield. Silver scalp hair, long pointed elven ears and a mature angular elven face with completely smooth cheeks, chin, neck, jaw and upper lip: no beard, moustache, sideburns, stubble or beard shadow. Travel-worn dark cloak over linen shirt, leather bracers and stellar medallions. One hand rests on the ship rail beside a grounded axe, the other cups a small golden Light spell. A galaxy, floating asteroids and glowing ship sails fill the distance. Calm watchful expression, natural hands, no readable markings.
entries.accent: deep star-field indigo with silver and pale gold light

entries.camera: Eye-level medium close-up seen through an open backstage doorway, 50mm look, the figure framed by the door edge, a theatre dressing room softly lit beyond.
entries.subject: A small autognome bard of the College of Creation, an investigator turned silver-tongued 'face' of the group, sitting on a velvet stool in a theatre dressing room and holding up a tiny wind-up music box that has sprouted little legs and is dancing on the palm of one hand. A polished copper body with enamelled trim, articulated brass joints, and a delicately crafted porcelain-like face plate with painted arched brows and glowing round amber eyes that crinkle with delight. A small hinged jaw is pulled into a charming smile. It wears a tiny embroidered waistcoat and a rakish plumed hat over a dome of clockwork. Around it, hanging costumes, a mirror with a string of warm bulbs, and a half-open trunk of props.
entries.accent: polished copper and enamel red with warm theatre-bulb gold

entries.camera: Chest-level three-quarter shot, 35mm look, the face and spread hands in focus, a lantern-lit evening market stall softly blurred behind.
entries.subject: A middle-aged female satyr bard of the College of Eloquence and a born charlatan, leaning over her market stall at dusk and spreading her hands in a disarming, sincere gesture with one eyebrow arched and a barely hidden smirk. An elf-like face with pointed ears, laugh lines, silver streaks in her dark curly hair, a pair of small curved goat horns wrapped with a ribbon and warm, knowing amber eyes. Two furry goat-like hind legs end in neat cloven hooves, and a short tail twitches behind the stall counter. She wears a flamboyant embroidered coat with too many buttons and several rings on each hand. Little glass bottles of coloured liquid, a velvet cloth and a polished fake gemstone are arranged on the counter, and strings of paper lanterns sway overhead.
entries.accent: warm lantern gold and plum with a teal evening sky

entries.camera: Side-lit three-quarter close-up, 85mm look, shot from beside the balustrade, the face glowing in dusk light, a palace garden and city lights blurred below.
entries.subject: A young male half-elf bard of the College of Lore, barely twenty, resting his elbows on a marble balcony balustrade at dusk with a lute slung across his back and a charming, slightly amused smile as if he has just thought of a clever remark. A half-elf with subtly pointed ears, fine cheekbones, tousled honey-brown hair and warm hazel eyes with a hint of green, a few ink stains on his cuff. He wears an elegant but rumpled noble's doublet with the top button undone, a signet ring on one hand and a small book tucked into his belt. A rapier rests unused at his hip. Behind him a palace garden lit with floating lanterns and the first stars above rooftops.
entries.accent: dusk rose and honey gold with deep twilight blue

entries.camera: Eye-level three-quarter medium shot, 50mm look, a brass orrery in the foreground slightly out of focus, a round tower study with tall windows behind.
entries.subject: A woman in her early thirties, a half-elf bard and sage, standing at a round tower study window and flicking a finger so that a small book floats open in the air beside her. Subtly pointed ears, warm deep-brown skin, a halo of tight dark curls pinned up with a pencil and round wire spectacles pushed down her nose over bright, delighted eyes. She wears a mismatched scholar's coat with ink-stained cuffs over a rumpled shirt, a small lute strapped to her back and a ring of tiny brass keys at her belt. Her half-smile says she has just solved something nobody else noticed. Shelves of scrolls, a glowing orrery and a window full of late afternoon clouds surround her.
entries.accent: warm brass and honey light with deep teal shadows and a soft arcane shimmer

entries.camera: Slightly high frontal medium close-up, 70mm look, the face lit from below by candles, a dark parlour table blurred in front and behind.
entries.subject: A young female gem dragonborn bard of the College of Spirits, sitting at a candlelit parlour table with her clawed hands resting lightly on a worn deck of blank cards and a gentle, faintly sad smile. An upright draconic humanoid with a dragon-like muzzle and emerald-green gem-bright scales that catch the candle flames in prismatic flecks, small swept-back horns and large, kind jade eyes with a haunted tiredness around them. She wears a faded velvet coat with an old silk scarf and a pendant of a polished green stone, no wings. A few pale, soft wisps of spirit-light curl around the candle flames and one drifts close to her shoulder as if listening. Dark wood panelling and a drawn curtain frame the intimate, quiet scene.
entries.accent: emerald and prismatic jewel glints with warm candle gold and cool ghost-white wisps

entries.camera: Low three-quarter hero shot, 35mm look, the figure on the right third in a bright castle courtyard, the rapier's point raised in a formal salute near the lens.
entries.subject: A young female lizardfolk bard and knight of the College of Swords, standing in a sunlit castle courtyard and raising a slender rapier in a graceful, courteous salute with a bright, open expression. An upright reptilian humanoid with a long scaly snout, green-brown scales fading to amber on her throat, alert slit-pupilled golden eyes, a thick tail balancing behind her and clawed fingers on the hilt. She wears supple studded leather in a deep burgundy, a short cape clasped with a plain silver pin and a plume of feathers tucked into a leather headband. A lute hangs at her hip. Morning light slides across pale stone arches and a crowd of blurred onlookers watches from a gallery.
entries.accent: fresh morning gold on pale stone with burgundy and emerald scale tones

entries.camera: Eye-level medium close-up, 50mm look, a tavern fireplace glowing softly behind, the horn in his hands slightly out of focus in the foreground.
entries.subject: A weathered male half-elf bard in his late thirties, a former criminal turned battle-minstrel, sitting on a tavern bench and polishing a curved brass horn with a rag while humming under his breath. Subtly pointed ears, dark brown skin with a pale scar through one eyebrow, a close beard going grey at the chin and relaxed, wry, amused eyes. He wears a patched chain shirt under a deep green coat with brass buttons and a light crossbow hangs on a hook on the wall beside his lute. A battered drum and a pair of dice sit on the bench beside him. Embers glow in the stone hearth and a quiet blur of other patrons fills the room.
entries.accent: hearth orange and brass with deep forest green and smoky brown

entries.camera: Eye-level medium close-up through a gap between marble pillars, 85mm look, the face in sharp focus, a masquerade ball glittering softly behind.
entries.subject: A changeling bard of the College of Whispers, shown in their natural form, lingering behind a pillar at a masquerade ball while holding a half-mask loosely at their side and watching a conversation across the room with a quiet, knowing smile. Ashen grey-white skin, smooth ambiguous features, pale silver hair swept back and very light, almost colourless eyes. One side of the face seems to ripple faintly, as though about to borrow another person's features. A charming, forgettable dark coat with a lace collar, a lute strapped across the back and clever hands, one with a thin ring of keys, the other with a folded note. Crowds of masked dancers blur into warm gold behind.
entries.accent: ashen silver skin against warm ballroom gold and deep plum

entries.camera: Eye-level medium shot at halfling height, 50mm look, shallow depth of field, the rapier's golden edge and her face in sharp focus, a ruined manor hall softly blurred behind.
entries.subject: A wiry stout halfling woman in her late thirties, a blood hunter of the Order of the Ghostslayer and a former sailor, standing in the doorway of a ruined manor hall at dawn with a slim rapier held low and ready in one hand. A sun-weathered, freckled face with a sharp jaw, a thin pale scar across one eyebrow, short-cropped dark curls tied back with a strip of red cloth and steady, watchful grey eyes; her expression is calm and resolute, no smile. She wears worn studded leather armour under a long dark hooded coat with the hood thrown back, a faded anchor tattoo on one wrist, and a light crossbow slung across her back. The edge of the rapier glows with the warm gold light of sunrise, and a faint crimson line of hemocraft light traces an old healed scar across her open palm. Behind her, a tall faceless shroud of pale spectral mist hangs among sheet-draped furniture and unravels into drifting glowing motes where the golden light touches it.
entries.accent: sunrise gold and hemocraft crimson against pale spectral teal mist

entries.camera: Low three-quarter shot from behind a toppled gravestone, 35mm look, the drawn shortbow and his face in sharp focus, a misty churchyard at dawn behind.
entries.subject: A stocky stout halfling man in his forties, a blood hunter of the Order of the Ghostslayer with a criminal past, kneeling behind a toppled gravestone in a misty churchyard at first light and drawing a short bow, the arrow aimed off-frame into the fog. A broad, ruddy face with a crooked once-broken nose, a short braided ginger beard, a thin pale scar across one cheek and narrowed, patient hazel eyes; his expression is focused and grimly amused. He wears dark studded leather armour under a weathered hooded travelling cloak, a dagger and a roll of thieves' tools at his belt and a quiver at his hip. The tip of the nocked arrow glows with warm sunrise gold, and a faint crimson line of hemocraft light traces an old healed scar along the back of his drawing hand. Far behind him, a pale faceless shape of spectral mist drifts between leaning headstones and thins into glowing motes where the dawn light reaches it.
entries.accent: dawn gold and hemocraft crimson against cold spectral teal fog and grey stone

entries.camera: Three-quarter medium character portrait, the face and hands clearly visible, with the activity and setting described in the subject filling the shot.
entries.subject: A mature MALE BUGBEAR ambush caster, tawny shaggy fur, broad bear-goblin muzzle, long pointed ears and long powerful arms, dark patched robes and component satchel. He crouches partly behind a fallen ancient standing stone in a misty fern forest at blue dawn, head and face clearly visible, body angled sideways in a cautious scouting pose. One large furry hand cups a single iridescent CHROMATIC ORB close to his chest, its restrained light hidden by his cloak from the empty path beyond. Ready and thoughtful, no enemies, no attack or harm. The guide's ambush-spellcaster premise, no reading, no book, no library, no round desk-orb pose.
entries.accent: natural cinematic lighting and the distinct scene-specific colours described in the Subject

entries.camera: Low-angle frontal medium shot, 35mm look, the figure standing in the nave of a ruined chapel with a tall broken window glowing behind her.
entries.subject: A young female bugbear warlock, an acolyte of a fiendish patron, standing in the nave of a ruined chapel and holding a tiny orange spark of eldritch light in her upturned palm with a thoughtful, slightly mischievous half-smile. A tall, broad goblinoid with coarse dark brown fur, a flat pink-brown nose, big rounded ears with a small ring and very long arms, ember-red glints in her amber eyes. She wears an acolyte's grey robe cut short for travel under a leather harness, a light crossbow slung across her back and a plain quarterstaff leaning on her arm. Candle stubs flicker along the broken pews and dusty shafts of light fall through the missing roof.
entries.accent: ember orange sparks against cold dusty blue-grey stone and warm candle gold

entries.camera: High three-quarter shot from slightly above, 35mm look, the figure kneeling beside a mossy headstone, a misty graveyard fading behind at twilight.
entries.subject: A woman in her thirties, a half-elf cleric of the Death domain and a faction agent, kneeling beside an old headstone in a misty graveyard at twilight and placing a single white flower on the moss with a calm, solemn expression. Subtly pointed ears, pale freckled skin, a long auburn braid over one shoulder and shadowed grey-green eyes with the steadiness of someone used to hard work. She wears a dark grey travelling cloak over practical leather and chain, a slim sword hung at her hip and a small pin on her collar with no readable design. A single candle burns in a lantern beside her and the mist glows faintly silver. Her hands show old calluses and a thin scar across one knuckle.
entries.accent: twilight silver-blue mist with a single warm candle gold and deep green moss

entries.camera: Eye-level frontal medium shot, 50mm look, the anvil glow lighting his face from below, a busy smithy blurred behind.
entries.subject: A broad, burly male half-elf cleric of the Forge domain in his fifties, a guild artisan, grinning with obvious pride as he holds a freshly forged iron blade up to the light of the forge. Subtly pointed ears, a ruddy, sweat-sheened face with a short salt-and-pepper beard, dark eyes with deep crow's-feet and thick forearms covered in small old burn scars. He wears a heavy leather apron over a mail shirt, a hammer on his belt and a pair of tongs across his shoulder, and a small holy symbol of a hammer and flame hangs at his chest. Sparks float up from the anvil and the coals of the forge glow orange. Racks of tools and finished horseshoes hang on the wall.
entries.accent: forge orange and molten gold against dark soot brown and steel grey

entries.camera: Three-quarter low-key close-up, 85mm look, shallow depth of field, a lonely hillside burial ground and a cave mouth soft in the evening haze behind.
entries.subject: An elderly male custom-lineage cleric of the Grave domain and a hermit, sitting on a flat stone beside an old burial mound with a bowl of water on his knee, gazing at his own reflection with a gentle, thoughtful expression. A tall, gaunt figure with ivory-pale skin, long silvery-white hair and a trimmed beard, and unusual silver-grey irises without visible pupils. The ancestry is an invented artistic choice, human-like with a faint unearthly stillness, no other anomalies. He wears a plain undyed wool robe with a worn leather belt and a holy symbol of a closed hand on a cord. A few pale wildflowers grow through the stones around him, a lantern burns softly and the evening sky behind him is layered in soft violet.
entries.accent: pale silver and violet dusk with a small warm lantern glow

entries.camera: Low three-quarter shot from the floor, 28mm look, the figure perched at the top of a rolling library ladder, towering shelves around her.
entries.subject: A female tabaxi cleric of the Knowledge domain and a sage, perched in a catlike crouch on the top of a rolling library ladder with a scroll unrolled across her knee and her tail curled around a rung. A feline humanoid covered in short golden fur with dark leopard-like rosettes, a true catlike face with whiskers, a pink nose, triangular ears with small gold rings and wide amber eyes with narrow pupils fixed on the text. She wears a light scholar's tunic with a leather belt of small pouches and a modest holy symbol on a cord. Her clawed fingers are tipped with ink. Motes of dust drift through shafts of afternoon light across the endless shelves.
entries.accent: golden fur and amber eyes in warm library light with soft leather brown

entries.camera: Eye-level medium close-up, 50mm look, a temple doorway behind him in soft morning light, the injured bird in his hands softly in focus.
entries.subject: A stout male hill dwarf cleric of the Life domain in his fifties, an acolyte, kneeling on temple steps and cradling a small sparrow with a bandaged wing in his cupped hands as a gentle golden warmth spreads from his palms. A broad, kind face with a thick grey-brown beard braided in two plaits, a crooked nose and warm brown eyes filled with tenderness. He wears polished banded armour over a simple white-and-gold tabard, a dagger at his belt and a small holy symbol in the shape of a sun at his chest. His thick fingers are scarred but remarkably careful. A pile of seed and a half-eaten loaf sit on the steps beside him in the quiet morning light.
entries.accent: soft golden healing glow with warm stone and cream white

entries.camera: Low-angle three-quarter hero shot, 35mm look, the figure on a grassy hilltop against a sunrise sky, hand raised toward the viewer.
entries.subject: A young human woman cleric of the Light domain, an acolyte, standing on a grassy hilltop at sunrise with one hand held up and a small ball of golden fire dancing above her palm, laughing with sheer joy. Dark brown skin, long locs gathered back with a yellow cloth, a wide bright smile and eyes full of reflected sunlight. She wears a sturdy scale-mail shirt under a yellow-and-white tabard, a round shield on her back, a dagger at her belt and a sun-disc holy symbol on a cord. The wind catches her tabard and the low sun rims her silhouette in gold. Wildflowers and a small chapel bell in the valley below glow warmly in the distance.
entries.accent: sunrise gold and rose with fresh green hills and a warm white fire

entries.camera: Eye-level frontal medium shot, 50mm look, symmetrical, a long marble courthouse corridor receding into soft light behind him.
entries.subject: A lean male shifter cleric of the Order domain and a former spy in his thirties, standing calmly in a courthouse corridor and holding a plain official staff of office upright beside him with a composed, watchful expression. A humanoid with a subtle fox-like aspect: tufted russet ears pointed upward, sharp canine teeth just visible, amber eyes with a slightly narrow gaze and fine coppery fur along his jaw and wrists. He wears a pressed dark coat over a mail shirt, a neat white collar and a plain silver holy symbol at his chest. His clean hands rest still, as someone used to listening more than talking. Late afternoon light slants across the polished floor and a pair of blurred clerks pass in the distance.
entries.accent: russet fur and amber eyes against cool marble and late afternoon gold

entries.camera: Eye-level three-quarter medium shot from the side, 85mm look, a temple garden with a stone fountain softly blurred behind.
entries.subject: A sturdy female custom-lineage cleric of the Peace domain in her early forties, an acolyte, sitting on the edge of a temple garden fountain and quietly mending a torn child's glove with needle and thread, a faint warm glow around her hands. Warm bronze skin, a round, calm face with deep dimples, thick dark hair in a long braid and unusually large, round dark eyes adapted to dim light. The ancestry is an invented artistic choice, human-like with a faint dusky shimmer to her skin. She wears a practical blue-green tunic with a wool shawl and a simple clay holy symbol on a cord. A small basket of mending and a flask of water sit next to her. Birdsong and trickling water fill the garden.
entries.accent: soft teal and bronze with warm sunlight through green leaves

entries.camera: Low-angle three-quarter shot on a windy clifftop, 28mm look, the figure on the left third, a stormy sea and a distant lighthouse behind.
entries.subject: A broad-shouldered male air genasi cleric of the Tempest domain in his forties, a sage, standing on a coastal clifftop with his arms folded and a small crackle of lightning running between his fingers, his white hair streaming upward as though lifted by a wind only he feels. Pale blue-grey skin with faint cloud-like swirls, calm slate-coloured eyes and a thoughtful half-smile. He wears a weathered chain mail shirt under a dark blue cloak that snaps in the wind, a plain warhammer at his belt and a small holy symbol of a cloud on a cord. Waves crash far below and a lone lighthouse beam crosses the rolling clouds. Wisps of cloud drift around his boots.
entries.accent: storm slate blue and cloud white with a bright electric blue spark

entries.camera: Medium-wide shot from front-left at the height of the withers, 35mm look, the whole upper body and forelegs in view, a twilight meadow with hanging lanterns behind.
entries.subject: A female centaur cleric of the Twilight domain in her thirties, a sage and herbalist, standing in a meadow at dusk and gently holding a bundle of freshly picked herbs while looking up at the first stars with a peaceful smile. Human torso, arms and head set naturally on a dapple-grey horse body with four legs, hooves, a broad barrel and a long silver tail. Freckled cheeks, a loose dark braid with wildflowers woven in and calm, dark-lashed grey eyes. A soft grey-blue tunic, a hide harness with a warhammer slung on the side, a herbalist's satchel and a small crescent-moon holy symbol.
